india_trends.title: Commerce minister Piyush Goyal asks Japanese companies to deepen localisation in India
india_trends.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has urged Japanese auto and capital goods companies to increase localisation, set up R&D and Global Capability Centres (GCCs), and build new manufacturing capacity in India to use the country as a base for global exports.

india_trends.title: Allied Blenders to produce Officer’s Choice Blue locally in Malaysia
india_trends.summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd will produce Officer's Choice Blue locally in Malaysia. This marks the company's first overseas local production initiative. The move supports ABDL's broader strategy for international footprint expansion. Malaysia's spirits segment is expected to grow significantl

india_trends.title: Paluck Technologies IPO: BSE SME declares IPO opening date, fixes price band at ₹46 to ₹48
india_trends.summary: Paluck Technologies has announced its IPO opening on August 28, 2026, targeting ₹33 crore with a price band of ₹46-48. The issue includes 68,76,000 equity shares, with portions for anchor investors and institutional buyers, aiming to fund machinery purchases and repay borrowings.

india_trends.title: ICICI raises $1 billion, Union Bank $600 million through dollar bonds
india_trends.summary: ICICI Bank raised $1 billion through a five-year private dollar bond, while Union Bank of India secured $600 million in its first international dollar issue in over a decade, benefiting from RBI’s special swap window. UCO Bank also approved a $1 billion programme.

india_trends.title: Onion prices up 59%, govt ramps up 'Kanda Express' supplies to cool market
india_trends.summary: The Centre has begun moving onion buffer stocks from Nashik to major consumption centres through dedicated railway rakes, or ‘Kanda Express’, to boost supplies and contain seasonal price increases.

india_trends.title: Hindustan Copper OFS: Government to sell up to 6% stake at ₹514 per share, 10% below market price
india_trends.summary: The Indian government plans to sell up to 6% stake in Hindustan Copper through an OFS, with a floor price of ₹514 per share, reflecting a 10.45% discount. The stock has risen 17% in August due to increased global copper prices and supply concerns.

india_trends.title: Ceigall India bags ₹705 crore Frontier Highway project in Arunachal Pradesh
india_trends.summary: Ceigall India has received a ₹704.70 crore order from MoRTH for constructing a section of NH-913 in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with Sushee Infra. The project, to be executed in 48 months, aims to enhance road connectivity in the region and expands Ceigall's infrastructure portfolio.

india_trends.title: PFC withdraws three-year bond issue as yields remain elevated in market
india_trends.summary: The state-owned lender raised ₹2,500 crore through a 15-year bond at a 7.55 per cent cut-off coupon, but withdrew its three-year issue after receiving bids at higher yields

india_trends.summary: Shanti Inorganics is set to launch its IPO from August 31 to September 2, aiming to raise ₹47.23 crore. The company plans to fund a new manufacturing facility in Ahmedabad, producing various sulphur-based chemicals.
